title: Dead Presidents
wikitext:
One of the first Norwegian Quake clans, and very active in the first years after Quake's release. Was resurrected in the early 2000s with former top Norwegian players like [[Stalin]], [[Sectopod]] and [[Pusling]], now without clans as the general QW scene was in decline and lots of players and clans was moving on to Counter-Strike and Quake III Arena. {{Clan-info | foundedyear = 1996 | foundedmonth = | foundedday = | foundedby = | nationality = Norwegian | shortnationality = no | prefix = [DP] | color1 = 4 | color2 = 4 | ircchannel = | ircnetwork = | ircnetworkname = | website = }} {| width="55%" | valign="top" | === Original members === * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Link|Lincoln]] * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Garfield * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] LBJ * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Truman * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Jackson * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Nixon * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Benjamin * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Ulysses * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Hoover * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Coolidge * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Eisenhower * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] Johnson | valign="top" | === 2000s members === * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Dark]] as Roosevelt * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Haggis]] as Chester * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Jargoon]] as Van Buren * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Link]] as Lincoln * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Pusling]] as Adams * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Sectopod]] as Kennedy * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Senil]] as Washington * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Stalin]] as Harding
